newsitem.title: UK: Second Oasis rock star cancels wedding - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Second Oasis rock star cancels wedding - newspaper.

text.p: Guitarist and songwriter Noel Gallagher of the top British pop group Oasis has cancelled his wedding less than a week after his younger brother called off his own nuptials, a newspaper said on Thursday.
Gallagher, 29, had planned to secretly wed girlfriend Meg Matthews on Valentine's Day while the media's attention was focused on the wedding of his brother Liam.
"The wedding was abandoned just days after Liam and fiancee Patsy Kensit cancelled their own marriage plans," the Mirror said.

The younger Gallagher scrapped his wedding at the last minute on Monday after 25 crates of champagne, boxes of wine and flowers had been delivered. He blamed "obsessive and intrusive media attention" for the change in plans.
Only a few close friends had been invited to Noel's private ceremony on Friday, which had been expected to take place on board a barge in North London.
Noel, the creative force of the band, had previously said he had no intention of going through with a big rock wedding.
The Gallagher brothers have featured frequently in the British tabloid press after Oasis hit the charts in 1993. Their first two albums sold 20 million copies.
